findings.summary: At 1622be1, CODEX-06-B stays within the seven authorized files and leaves the controller-owned fixture-audio.mjs unchanged. It keeps the 06-A legacy path and implements the specified engine2 validation, shared sequence and action-ID registry, reversible graduated help, a separately labelled show-it demonstration, three explicitly authored script paths with retained tries, an optional side thread and a gesture-driven fixed-audio controller with text fallback. The round-1 blocker is resolved. Real-browser observations on exact commit 1622be1 list source blobs that match the diff index hashes. They cover 320px reflow, keyboard-only operation with visible focus, native tone decode, play and ended, mute and replay, and the simulated error fallback with Test, compare and help still working afterwards. The minor findings (separate parent limits, help-specific rejection text, conditional aria-controls) are fixed at LoopPlayer.tsx:85, :105, :130 and :142. On this tree the controller's npm test passed 30/30, and the build and check_application_card.py both exited 0. Voice-sample, human-content-review and deployment gates remain open as required.

findings.title: REPORT.md status line is stale; browser section cites 2370a16
findings.problem: The card requires the completion record to give exact revisions and checks. The report's opening status line and its earlier table still read 'correction draft awaiting controller checks' and NOT YET RUN. Only the appended section says it supersedes them. That section attributes the browser observations to source 2370a16, but the final gate observation was taken on 1622be1 (identical UI blobs). A reader of the top of the file gets a stale picture.
findings.fix_check: When the report is next updated, its status line reflects the actual verified state. The browser observation names reviewed commit 1622be1 alongside the unchanged source blobs.

findings.title: Exact browser QA record file was not readable by the reviewer
findings.problem: The controller's exact-candidate record at .agent-loop/browser-qa/CODEX-06-B/1622be14af6f8434adafe095a9d153571b46632b.json was outside this reviewer's read permission. I checked the inline copy supplied in the review request instead. Its commit and source blobs are consistent with the diff (LoopPlayer 0c7794e, css fc7335f, assisted-player 06acf4e, assisted-fixture 6a9ca89, fixed-audio d774057, fixture-audio 158a50d). Screenshots were not saved as artifacts, which the record itself states as a limitation.
findings.fix_check: The merge step confirms that the on-disk browser QA record matches the inline evidence. Saving screenshots would be optional future hardening.

findings.title: fixedLines.test and fixedLines.compare are never played by the UI
findings.problem: Only the Listen button plays the 'ready' line. The test and compare system lines exist in fixed-audio.mjs and are covered by unit tests, but no UI control or flow plays them. This does not block any acceptance criterion, because the instructions specify a Listen button for the ready line.
findings.fix_check: Either wire the test and compare lines to explicit gesture controls in a later card, or accept them as reserved lines in ASSISTANCE_CONTRACT.md.
